newsitem.title: USA: Superior National in talks on Golden Eagle.
newsitem.headline: Superior National in talks on Golden Eagle.

text.p: Superior National Insurance Group Inc Tuesday said it is in talks with the California Department of Insurance, Insurance Partners L.P. and members of the Zurich Centre Group about implementing a plan of rehabilitation for privately held Golden Eagle Insurance Co.

Golden Eagle is a California insurer that wrote approximately $400 million of workers' compensation, and $300 million of property and casualty business in 1996, It was placed under supervision of the California Department of Insurance on Jan. 31, 1997.

In a statement, Superior National said it expects the plan of rehabilitation will include significant reinsurance and financial support as well as underwriting and other service involvement, by Superior, with Zurich in order to preserve Golden Eagle's value for the benefit of its policyholders and other constituencies.

As part of the plan, Superior National said it anticipates raising up to $65 million in new capital through the sale of common stock, $32.5 million of which would be obtained through a pro-rata common stock offering to Superior's existing warrant and shareholders, and $32.5 million of which would be obtained in a private issuance of common stock to Insurance Partners.

Superior said it has entered into a letter of intent with Insurance Partners whereby Insurance Partners agreed to provide up to $32.5 million in a private transaction and agreed to purchase any shares not taken in the offering to Super National's shareholders.

The shares issued to Insurance Partners in the private transaction would be sold at a price of $11.775, the average closing price of Superior's common stock for the 10 trading days ended on Jan. 29, 1997.
